rounds.title: Round 1 · Launch
rounds.forecast: Modest traffic. Pick a server size: idle capacity costs money, a slow shop loses customers.

options.label: Small server
options.blurb: Cheap. Slows down if demand runs hot.

options.label: Large server
options.blurb: Never slow. You pay for it every week.

rounds.title: Round 2 · Growth
rounds.forecast: Traffic doubles. The database on your server's disk is the limit, and customers have saved carts.

options.label: Stay on the server's disk
options.blurb: No migration. You can't add servers later.

options.label: Careful migration
options.blurb: Copy every table to a shared PostgreSQL database.

options.label: Fast migration
options.blurb: Skip the carts table. Cheap and quick.

rounds.title: Round 3 · Black Friday
rounds.forecast: A huge spike and impatient shoppers who retry. Scale, queue or ride it out.

options.label: Autoscale
options.blurb: Add servers as traffic grows. Cost grows with it.
options.dice_text: Under 20: scaled too late, slow for the first hours

requires.reason: Needs a shared database from Round 2

options.label: Queue checkouts
options.blurb: Never fails, but confirmations are slower.
options.dice_text: Under 10: retries charged some customers twice

rounds.title: Round 4 · Christmas
rounds.forecast: Steady high demand. Returning customers check their carts and orders.

options.label: Scale down
options.blurb: Cheap. Slow if demand stays high.

options.label: Commit to steady capacity
options.blurb: Cheaper per hour, paid even when quiet. Pricing modelled, not measured.
